result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only visual defect is the third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, whose title is clipped mid-word at the right edge ('Trattoria Piccol...'), which reads as a broken/truncated label rather than an intentional carousel affordance. Everything else (partially visible carousel card, card cut off at the viewport bottom) is expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off mid-word at the right screen edge with no ellipsis or fade, making the text look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single-line ellipsis truncation (text-overflow: ellipsis) to card titles, or add a right-edge gradient fade/hint so partially visible carousel items read as scrollable instead of clipped.
